requirements.text: The system shall require a password of at least 8 characters.
The system shall lock the account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.
The system shall allow users to reset their password via an emailed link valid for 30 minutes.
The system should offer optional two-factor authentication using a one-time code.
ac: Enabling 2FA requires confirming one valid code.

requirements.text: The system must log out an idle session after 20 minutes.
ac: After 20 minutes of inactivity the next action redirects to login.

requirements.text: The system shall display a generic error message for invalid credentials.
ac: The message does not reveal whether the email exists.
